final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS wp, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avgband, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avgband) AS overall FROM step1) SELECT s1.wp, s1.avgband, s1.cnt, s1.avgband - s2.overall AS diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall IS NOT NULL
